decisions.reason: Because this carrier wafer stays close to the firm's core handling business and uses capabilities already in place, management is inclined to continue it and explain any weak performance by customer qualification cycles rather than abandon it quickly.

As a publicly launched flagship technology tied to the firm's stated move toward more complex packaging wafers, this product carries strong commitment and is likely to be defended despite uncertain short-term results.

The off-the-shelf wafer brand represents a visible strategic commitment with several models and only limited distance from the established offer, so management would be especially reluctant to withdraw it.

Glass-based circuit boards sit noticeably farther from the firm's established substrate niche and announced direction, so if traction remains unclear management is more likely to stop the product and reallocate resources.
